verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Firebase Authentication SDK supports sign-in with Google, Facebook, Twitter and GitHub. They also describe FirebaseUI as a drop-in auth solution that handles email/password and federated sign-in flows. Community users say account management and libraries 'come for free' and praise auth for bootstrapping, which loosely supports the ease claim. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the 'in minutes' setup time (e.g., a documented quickstart or hands-on timing), and independent corroboration specific to wiring up email/password plus OAuth.
